newsitem.title: USA: Mass. voters approve Cape Cod land bank - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mass. voters approve Cape Cod land bank - paper.

text.p: Massachusetts voters approved a Cape Cod Land Bank referendum by a margin of 55 percent, the Boston Globe said on Thursday.

The nonbinding referendum urges the legislature to tax all Cape real estate transactions over $100,000 and less than $1 million at a one percent rate to help pay for buying open space. A total of 56,991 approved the bill, which was opposed by 47,484, the paper said.

The bill already has been filed and approved by the Joint Committee on Taxation, the bill's author, Representative Eric Turkington, D-Falmouth, told the paper. The next step is for the legislature to take up the bill and hold hearings.
Were the bill in place, Turkington said it would bring in about $5 million a year to help pay for buying open space for well sites, recreation areas and green space, the Globe said.
